dedupe_keys.name: time series dataset for modeling and forecasting of n2o in wastewater treatment

description: Time Series Dataset for Modeling and Forecasting of N2O in Wastewater Treatment is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Laura Debel Hansen, Anju Rani. This dataset presents two years of high-resolution nitrous oxide (N2O) measurements for time series modeling and forecasting in wastewater treatment plants (WWTP). The dataset comprises frequent, real-time measurements from a full-scale WWTP, with a sample interval of 2 minutes, making it ideal for developing models for real-time operation and control. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
